Introduction
============

Windows File Sharing, aka Server Message Block (SMB), is the standard client-server protocol used by Windows to share resources over a local network. SMB is available on all Windows computers and can be easily setup by the home user. SMB can also be accessed by other operating systems, which makes SMB the most commonly used network protocol to access content on a NAS or other remote hardware.

**Note:** SMB v1 is not supported in Kodi. SMB v2 or higher must be used.

This page will detail how to add a network source to Kodi using SMB. It assumes you have already correctly set up your SMB network.|If you have not set up your SMB network, a Google search will return numerous online guides. The following links may help also.

*   Android : [How-To Geek](https://www.howtogeek.com/191378/how-to-access-shared-windows-folders-on-android-ipad-and-iphone/)
    
*   Linux : [SAMBA](http://www.samba.org/)
    .
*   Mac : [macOS User Guide site](https://support.apple.com/en-au/guide/mac-help/mh17131/10.15)
    
*   Windows : [Forum step-by-step guide](https://forum.kodi.tv/showthread.php?tid=362113)
    

  

Settings
========

Check _**[Settings ► Services ► SMB Client](https://kodi.wiki/view/Settings/Services/SMB_Client "Settings/Services/SMB Client")
**_ page for SMB related settings in Kodi.

  

Methods
=======

Once SMB is implemented and the Source folders containing your media have been given Read/Write permission the [Source folder](https://kodi.wiki/view/Source_folder "Source folder")
(s) can be added to Kodi

Two methods are available- _Windows Network (SMB)_ and _Add Network Location_ detailed below. _Windows Network (SMB)_ method being the simplest.

From the **Browse for new share** window _(image 1 in both sections)_, select one of the following methods:

  

Windows Network (SMB)
---------------------

*   [![Image 1- Select Windows network (SMB) from the Browse for new shares list.](https://kodi.wiki/images/5/5b/Add-Network-Location_8.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_8.jpg "Image 1- Select Windows network (SMB) from the Browse for new shares list.")
    
    Image 1- Select **Windows network (SMB)** from the **Browse for new shares** list.
    
*   [![Image 2- Continue to drill down until the required Source folder is located, then select OK.](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/9d/Add-Network-Location_7.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_7.jpg "Image 2- Continue to drill down until the required Source folder is located, then select OK.")
    
    Image 2- Continue to drill down until the required Source folder is located, then select **OK**.
    

When SMB v1 was deprecated by Microsoft due to security reasons, it was no longer possible to browse SMB shares. Instead it required you to add the specific IP Address or Device Name followed by the path to access shares. (detailed in the next section)

As of **Kodi v19.1**, the **[WS-Discovery protocol](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WS-Discovery "w:WS-Discovery")
** was implemented to allow browsing SMB shares again. [\[1\]](https://kodi.wiki/view/SMB#cite_note-1)
 [\[2\]](https://kodi.wiki/view/SMB#cite_note-2)

WS-Discovery is enabled by default on all Windows 10 installations and is well supported from Windows 7.

To add a share using this method, select **Windows network (SMB)** (image 1) from the **Browse for new shares** page, then browse to the required **[Source folder](https://kodi.wiki/view/Source_folder "Source folder")
**.

  

  

Add Network Location
--------------------

*   [![Image 1- Select Add network location... from the Browse for new shares list.](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/9e/Add-Network-Location.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location.png "Image 1- Select Add network location... from the Browse for new shares list.")
    
    Image 1- Select **Add network location...** from the **Browse for new shares** list.
    
*   [![Image 2- Select Windows network (SMB) for Protocol. Then select Server Name.](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/96/Add-Network-Location_2.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_2.png "Image 2- Select Windows network (SMB) for Protocol. Then select Server Name.")
    
    Image 2- Select **Windows network (SMB)** for **Protocol**.  
    Then select **Server Name**.
    
*   [![Image 3- Type in either the IP Address or the Device name of your server.](https://kodi.wiki/images/2/29/Add-Network-Location_3.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_3.png "Image 3- Type in either the IP Address or the Device name of your server.")
    
    Image 3- Type in either the **IP Address** or the **Device name** of your server.
    
*   [![Image 4a- Using IP Address 4.1 Browse is not supported. 4.2 In the Shared folder section, type in the name of the folder to add. Add the drive letter eg f/Movies. 4.3 If your share requires a Username and Password enter them in the appropriate sections. 4.4 Select OK](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3f/Add-Network-Location_4.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_4.png "Image 4a- Using IP Address 4.1 Browse is not supported. 4.2 In the Shared folder section, type in the name of the folder to add. Add the drive letter eg f/Movies. 4.3 If your share requires a Username and Password enter them in the appropriate sections. 4.4 Select OK")
    
    Image 4a- Using **IP Address**  
    **4.1** Browse is not supported.  
    **4.2** In the **Shared folder** section, type in the name of the folder to add.  
    Add the drive letter _eg f/Movies_.  
    **4.3** If your share requires a **Username** and **Password** enter them in the appropriate sections.  
    **4.4** Select **OK**
    
*   [![Image 4b- Using Device Name 5.1 Browse is not supported. 5.2 In the Shared folder section, type in the name of the folder to add The drive letter is not required. 5.3 If your share requires a Username and Password enter them in the appropriate sections. 5.4 Select OK](https://kodi.wiki/images/2/20/Add-Network-Location_5.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_5.jpg "Image 4b- Using Device Name 5.1 Browse is not supported. 5.2 In the Shared folder section, type in the name of the folder to add The drive letter is not required. 5.3 If your share requires a Username and Password enter them in the appropriate sections. 5.4 Select OK")
    
    Image 4b- Using **Device Name**  
    **5.1** Browse is not supported.  
    **5.2** In the **Shared folder** section, type in the name of the folder to add  
    The drive letter is not required.  
    **5.3** If your share requires a **Username** and **Password** enter them in the appropriate sections.  
    **5.4** Select **OK**
    
*   [![Image 6- Your share should appear in the Browse for new share list. The share will show either the IP Address or Device Name depending on which method you used.](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/45/Add-Network-Location_6.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Add-Network-Location_6.jpg "Image 6- Your share should appear in the Browse for new share list. The share will show either the IP Address or Device Name depending on which method you used.")
    
    Image 6- Your share should appear in the **Browse for new share** list.  
    The share will show either the IP Address or Device Name depending on which method you used.
    

If the previous method is not available to you, then Shares can still be manually added using either the IP Address or Device Name method.

IP address

If using the IP Address method, ensure you reserve a DHCP address (static IP) for your NAS or other hardware. This ensures that your router will always allocate the same IP address to the server. If you choose not to do this, then you may find that the router has allocated a different address to your NAS and Kodi will no longer be able to access the media files.

To reserve a static IP address, log into your router and add the MAC address of the hardware to the Reservation list in your Router. If you do not know the MAC address, you should see it in the list of connected clients.

Device Name

If using Windows PC's you can use the Device Name of the PC.

The Device Name can be found in your Windows PC under _Settings > System > About_.

  
**Note:** Choose either Step 4a (IP Address) or Step 4b (Device Name), not both

------------------------------------------

### What about the Apple TV 4K?

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/ff/Stop_hand.png) | Unfortunately the Apple TV 4K does not have a USB-C. If you are not jailbroken the only official way to sideload Kodi on your device is to use Xcode on macOS with a wireless connection.<br><br>To get macOS on you computer you can use a virtual machine or check for building an [hackintosh](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hackintosh "w:Hackintosh")<br>, but we will not discuss this here. |

  

### Prerequisites

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/ff/Stop_hand.png) | Cydia Impactor is still a work-in-progress, There might be some bugs that you face while installing Kodi. It is not for the faint of heart.<br><br>This method also requires that Kodi be re-installed every **7 days** if you are using a free Apple developer account. |

  

*   [Cydia Impactor](http://cydiaimpactor.com/)
    
*   Windows 7 or higher
*   Latest version of iTunes is needed to be installed.
*   Kodi .deb file for tvOS: [Kodi 17.6 from Memphiz YAB branch (old but stable)](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/test-builds/darwin/tvos/kodi-20180227-4a25e62-yab-tvos.deb)
     **OR** [latest Kodi 19 nightly build (it's an alpha version...)](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/darwin/tvos/)
    
*   A USB-C cable, without that, you can't connect your Apple TV with computer

### Converting deb into ipa

Before beginning the installation, you have to convert .deb file of Kodi into .ipa. That is because Cydia Impactor only accepts .ipa files and not .deb files. If you already know how to convert .deb into .ipa, you can skip to the installation below.

*   You will need to [Download 7-zip](http://www.7-zip.org/download.html/)
     and install it in your PC

**Follow the steps given below and you will be able to convert .deb file into .ipa file.**

*   [![Step 1: Right Click on .deb file of Kodi that you downloaded on your PC and Select 7-zip > Extract files. Click OK in the next Window.](https://kodi.wiki/images/2/21/Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc1.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc1.jpg "Step 1: Right Click on .deb file of Kodi that you downloaded on your PC and Select 7-zip > Extract files. Click OK in the next Window.")
    
    **Step 1:** Right Click on .deb file of Kodi that you downloaded on your PC and Select 7-zip > Extract files. Click OK in the next Window.
    
*   [![Step 2: Open the resulting Folder and you will find data.tar file inside. Simply extract data.tar file with Right Click > 7-zip > Extract Files.](https://kodi.wiki/images/7/75/Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc3.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc3.jpg "Step 2: Open the resulting Folder and you will find data.tar file inside. Simply extract data.tar file with Right Click > 7-zip > Extract Files.")
    
    **Step 2:** Open the resulting Folder and you will find data.tar file inside. Simply extract data.tar file with Right Click > 7-zip > Extract Files.
    
*   [![Step 3: Now you should have data folder and data.tar file in the folder.](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/42/Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc4.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc4.jpg "Step 3: Now you should have data folder and data.tar file in the folder.")
    
    **Step 3:** Now you should have data folder and data.tar file in the folder.
    
*   [![Step 4: Go inside the data folder and open Applications folder. Here you will find a folder named Kodi.app.](https://kodi.wiki/images/1/1d/Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc5.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Convert-.deb-file-into-.ipa-file-on-windows-pc5.jpg "Step 4: Go inside the data folder and open Applications folder. Here you will find a folder named Kodi.app.")
    
    **Step 4:** Go inside the data folder and open Applications folder. Here you will find a folder named Kodi.app.

Install from Mac
----------------

### Prerequisites

*   [iOS App Signer](http://dantheman827.github.io/ios-app-signer/)
    
*   An iCloud account (required to download Xcode and to obtain your signing certificate and the provisioning profile)
*   Xcode (you can download it directly from your Mac App Store)
*   Kodi .deb file for tvOS: [Kodi 17.6 from Memphiz YAB branch (old but stable)](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/test-builds/darwin/tvos/kodi-20180227-4a25e62-yab-tvos.deb)
     **OR** [latest Kodi 19 nightly build (it's an alpha version...)](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/darwin/tvos/)
    
*   (optional) A USB-C cable if you have the Apple TV 4 (but just like the Apple TV 4K, the Apple TV 4 can also communicates wirelessly)

### Connect your device

If you have an Apple TV 4 and a USB-C cable you can power on your device and plug in with your Mac. Else if you have an Apple TV 4K or an Apple TV 4 without a USB-C cable you will need to pair your device wirelessly with Xcode. You can follow the step-by-step guide below.

*   [![Step 1: On your Apple TV open "Settings".](https://kodi.wiki/images/a/ae/Pair_atv4_1bis.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Pair_atv4_1bis.png "Step 1: On your Apple TV open "Settings".")
    
    **Step 1:** On your Apple TV open "Settings".

### Generate Kodi IPA file from deb file

**If you have a free Apple developper account (this is usually the case if you are a "lambda" user) please follow the section [FREE Apple dev account](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_on_Apple_TV_4_and_5_(HD_and_4K)#.28option_A.29_FREE_Apple_dev_account)
, else if you have a paid developper account (99$/year) please follow the [PAID Apple dev account](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_on_Apple_TV_4_and_5_(HD_and_4K)#.28option_B.29_PAID_Apple_dev_account)
 section.**

#### (option A) FREE Apple dev account without [Top Shelf](https://streambuzz.net/apple-tv-top-shelf/)

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/45/Emblem-important-yellow.png) | **NOTICE:**  <br>If you are using a free Apple developper account you will need to re-sign and re-install Kodi every 7 days and the [Top Shelf](https://streambuzz.net/apple-tv-top-shelf/)<br> feature will not work |

Follow the step-by-step guide below in order to (i) obtain a valid signing certificate and provisioning profile for your Kodi app and (ii) pack and sign Kodi _.deb_ file in an _.ipa_ file

*   [![Step 1: Open Xcode and click on "Create a new Xcode project".](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/48/Generata_ipa_atv_free_1.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Generata_ipa_atv_free_1.png "Step 1: Open Xcode and click on "Create a new Xcode project".")
    
    **Step 1:** Open Xcode and click on "Create a new Xcode project".
    
*   [![Step 2: Choose "tvOS" and "Single View App" then click on "Next".](https://kodi.wiki/images/b/b6/Generata_ipa_atv_free_2.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Generata_ipa_atv_free_2.png "Step 2: Choose "tvOS" and "Single View App" then click on "Next".")
    
    **Step 2:** Choose "tvOS" and "Single View App" then click on "Next".
    
*   [![Step 3: Fill the "Product Name" with "kodi", choose your Apple account name for the team, choose your name for the "Organization Name" and "com.yourusername" (without any space) for your "Organization identifier". Then click on "Next".](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/4e/Generata_ipa_atv_free_3.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Generata_ipa_atv_free_3.png "Step 3: Fill the "Product Name" with "kodi", choose your Apple account name for the team, choose your name for the "Organization Name" and "com.yourusername" (without any space) for your "Organization identifier".     **Step 3:** Fill the "Product Name" with "kodi", choose your Apple account name for the team, choose your name for the "Organization Name" and "com.yourusername" (without any space) for your "Organization identifier". Then click on "Next".

    **Step 4:** Finally choose a location for the Xcode project then click on "Create".

    **Step 5:** Your Xcode project is now alive, open the devices list by clicking on the target device on the top left.

    **Step 6:** Choose your your "real" connected Apple TV. Also, check for a "Fix issue" button on the signing panel, if this button is present click on it. Now you can close your Xcode window.

Install on a jailbroken Apple TV
--------------------------------

It is simple to get Kodi working on your [jailbroken](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/iOS_jailbreaking "w:iOS jailbreaking")
 Apple TV. Here you can find the current tvOS versions with an available jailbreak for the Apple TV 4 and 4K:

*   **10.2.2 to 11.1:** [backr00m](https://wiki.awkwardtv.org/wiki/Backr00m)
    
*   **11.0 to 11.4.1:** [electraTV](https://coolstar.org/electra/)
    
*   **12.0 to 12.1.1:** [chimeraTV](https://chimera.sh/)
    
*   **13.4.5 and below** [unc0verTV](https://unc0ver.dev/tvos/)
    
*   **All versions** [Checkra1n](https://checkra.in/)
    

Once your Apple TV is jailbroken:

1.  Download the Kodi .deb file for tvOS: [latest Kodi nightly build](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/darwin/tvos/)
     **OR** [Kodi 17.6 from Memphiz YAB branch (old)](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/test-builds/darwin/tvos/kodi-20180227-4a25e62-yab-tvos.deb)
     and put it on your Desktop.
2.  Open a terminal window on your computer.
3.  Move to your desktop with `cd ~/Desktop`.
4.  Send the deb file to your Apple TV with `scp DEB_FILE root@IP_ADDRESS:/var/root/'` (adapt with your case, for example `scp kodi-20180227-4a25e62-yab-tvos.deb [[email protected]](https://kodi.wiki/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) :/var/root/`), the default password is `alpine`.
5.  Connect to your Apple TV with `ssh root@IP_ADDRESS`, default password is `alpine`.
6.  Install Kodi with `dpkg -i /var/root/kodi-20180227-4a25e62-yab-tvos.deb`.
7.  Refresh icons cache with `uicache`.
8.  Kodi should be on your main Apple TV screen.

[Source](https://wiki.awkwardtv.org/wiki/Installing_Deb_Files)

Introduction
============

Kodi has the ability to include Music Videos in the [Video](https://kodi.wiki/view/Video_library "Video library")
 and [Music](https://kodi.wiki/view/Music_library "Music library")
 libraries. All scanned music videos will show up in both. Music Videos can also be part of [Party Mode](https://kodi.wiki/view/Playlists#Party_Mode_Playlist "Playlists")
 and [Smart Playlists](https://kodi.wiki/view/Playlists#Smart_Playlists "Playlists")
. Playlists containing both music and music videos should be stored in the mixed playlist subfolder under the [userdata](https://kodi.wiki/view/Userdata "Userdata")
 folder.

  

Naming
======

Music Video file naming is as follows:

**Artist - Title.mkv**

**NOTE:** The space either side of the hyphen is important!

  

File structure
==============

All music videos should be in a single folder named exactly as the above examples.

[![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/ee/Mvids-Structure.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Mvids-Structure.jpg)

  

  

**[Return to top](https://kodi.wiki/view/Music_videos#top)
**

From Official Kodi Wiki

[Jump to navigation](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#mw-head)

The current stable release for iOS is Kodi v21.3 Omega.

Requirements

*   To **install Kodi for iOS/iPadOS** you must have one of the following:
    *   a jailbroken [iDevice](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/iDevice "w:iDevice")
         running iOS 6.0 or higher, though iOS 8.0 or higher is recommended
    *   a normal iDevice running iOS 6.0 or higher and a Mac running Xcode 7 and higher
*   For hardware: iPad, iPhone and iPod touch.

Kodi 32-bit or 64-bit?
----------------------

Whichever installation method you will follow to install Kodi on your Apple device, you will need to choose between a 32-bit Kodi package or a 64-bit Kodi package. This choice depends on the processor of your device:

**32-bit (ios-arm):**

*   iPhone 1st generation, 3G, 3GS, 4, 4S, 5 and 5C
*   iPod Touch 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th generation
*   iPad 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th generation
*   iPad Mini 1st generation

**64-bit (ios-arm64):**

*   All other newer iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch

Which version of Kodi can I install?
------------------------------------

*   **iOS 9.0 and above:** latest working Kodi release version is Kodi v21.3 Omega
*   **iPadOS 13.1 and above:** latest working Kodi release version is Kodi v21.3 Omega
*   **iOS 8.4.1 and below** latest working Kodi release version is Kodi v17.6 Krypton

Download Kodi package
---------------------

Some installation methods given below will ask you to download a Kodi package (`.deb` file). You will find this file in the current section. First, check if your device needs a [32 bit or a 64 bit Kodi build](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Kodi_32-bit_or_64-bit.3F)
.

### Latest stable Kodi release

*   [Latest stable Kodi package for 64-bit devices](https://mirrors.kodi.tv/releases/darwin/ios-arm64/org.xbmc.kodi-ios_21.3_iphoneos-arm64.deb?https=1)
    

Latest Kodi version is not available for 32-bit devices. See below how to download previous releases.

#### Removing settings

Kodi will uninstall from your iDevice but will leave certain things ([Databases](https://kodi.wiki/view/Databases "Databases")
 and everything in your [Userdata](https://kodi.wiki/view/Userdata "Userdata")
) behind to make it easier if you wanted to reinstall. To delete those:

*   From the terminal, run rm -Rf /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/XBMC/ and rm -Rf /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/Kodi/.
*   Or from iFile/Filza delete /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/XBMC/ and /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/Kodi/.

### (option B) Install from iFile

1.  Install iFile from Cydia if you don't already have it.
2.  In Mobile Safari (or any browser that can download files) open the `.deb` file you wish to install, such as from the locations noted [here](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Download_Kodi_package)
    .
    
    _(e.g: `http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/darwin/ios/xbmc-20111202-6729214-master-ios.deb`)_
    
3.  Wait for the download to complete.
    
    **Note:** Mobile Safari won't show a progress bar for downloads. Just wait a few minutes until the download is done, but don't close Safari.
    
4.  Select **"Open in..."**
5.  Select **iFile** from the available apps
6.  iFile will get a copy of the downloaded file and open an action menu. Select **install**. When iFile is complete you can tap **done** at the top.
7.  In iFile, swipe to delete the downloaded Kodi deb file as it is no longer needed.

**Note:** To go back to a stable version of Kodi you might need to first uninstall Kodi and then use the normal install instructions, or manually download the stable release deb file and install using the dev build instructions.

### (option C) Install from Filza

1.  Install Filza from Cydia if you don't already have it.
2.  In Mobile Safari (or any browser that can download files) open the `.deb` file you wish to install, such as from the locations noted [here](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Download_Kodi_package)
    .
    
    _(e.g: `http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/darwin/ios/xbmc-20111202-6729214-master-ios.deb`)_
    
3.  Wait for the download to complete.
    
    **Note:** Mobile Safari won't show a progress bar for downloads. Just wait a few minutes until the download is done, but don't close Safari.
    
4.  Select **"Open in..."**
5.  Select **Filza** from the available apps
6.  Filza will open and get a copy of the downloaded. In the files list, select the freshly downloaded file and choose **install**.
7.  When you see `bash-5.0#` at the bottom of your screen you can select **respring** at the top right and **yes**.

### (option A) Install from Xcode and iOS App Signer

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/ff/Stop_hand.png) | This is considered and advanced and slightly-expirimental method. It is not for the faint of heart.  <br>This method also requires that Kodi be re-installed every **7 days** if you are using a free iOS dev account.  <br>To get macOS on you computer you can use a virtual machine or check for building an [hackintosh](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hackintosh "w:Hackintosh")<br>, but we will not discuss this here.  <br>If unable to access a macOS, jump to [Sideload a self signed .ipa file](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Sideload_a_self_signed_.ipa_file) |

  

#### Prerequisites

*   [iOS App Signer](http://dantheman827.github.io/ios-app-signer/)
    
*   Mac OS X 10.9 or higher
*   Xcode 7 or higher

#### Downloads

Download the Kodi package by following this [section](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Download_Kodi_package)
.

If you have additional devices -Plug in the device -Go to the Product Menu -Under Destination, select your device -Repeat from step 3](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/91/Ios-app-signer-howto-6.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Ios-app-signer-howto-6.png "Step 6: After fixing the issue, Xcode shouldn't have any errors. #### Updating Kodi

To update Kodi, run iOS App Signer and select the new deb file and the same provisioning profile that you used initially.

#### Modifying Kodi userdata

To modify the Kodi userdata, you can use any iOS file manager such as [iFunbox](http://www.i-funbox.com/)

#### Help

If you are having trouble using iOS App Signer, please post in the [forum topic](http://forum.kodi.tv/showthread.php?tid=245978)

### (option B) Sideload a self signed .ipa file

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/ff/Stop_hand.png) | Currently, these methods require that Kodi be re-installed every **7 days** if you are using a free iOS dev account. |

#### Prerequisites

*   Windows 7 or Higher
*   [7-Zip](https://www.7-zip.org/)
    
*   A `.deb` file of Kodi (see this [section](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Download_Kodi_package)
    )

#### Converting deb into ipa

Before beginning the installation, you have to convert .deb file of Kodi into .ipa. If you already know how to convert .deb into .ipa, you can skip to the installation methods below.

*   You will need to [Download 7-zip](http://www.7-zip.org/download.html/)
     and install it in your PC
*   Download required kodi build from the links [given above](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_for_iOS#Download_Kodi_package)
     in your PC

**Follow the steps given below and you will be able to convert .deb file into .ipa file.**

*   [![Step 1: Right Click on .deb file of Kodi that you downloaded on your PC and Select 7-zip > Extract files. ##### Installing Kodi using Sideloadly

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/ff/Stop_hand.png) | Sideloadly is still a work-in-progress and there might be some bugs that you face while installing Kodi. |

**Note:** Windows or macOS can be used for this method.

Make sure you have the following software on your computer or mac:

*   [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io/)
    

Procedure, step by step:

*   [![Step 1: Connect your iDevice with your computer, and make sure that it is turned ON. If iTunes or some other program pops up then close that first.](https://kodi.wiki/images/a/a3/Lightning_Dock_in_iPad_mini.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Lightning_Dock_in_iPad_mini.jpg "Step 1: Connect your iDevice with your computer, and make sure that it is turned ON. If iTunes or some other program pops up then close that first.")
    
    **Step 1:** Connect your iDevice with your computer, and make sure that it is turned ON. If iTunes or some other program pops up then close that first.
    
*   [![Sideloadly main window](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/49/Sideloadly_main_window.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Sideloadly_main_window.png "Step 2: Open Sideloadly and check your device is detected. Enter your Apple account, choose your Kodi ipa file and press Start button. You will be asked to enter your Apple account password and verification code. This is required by Sideloadly to sign the ipa file with your own ID.")
    
    **Step 2:** Open Sideloadly and check your device is detected. Enter your Apple account, choose your Kodi ipa file and press Start button. You will be asked to enter your Apple account password and verification code. This is required by Sideloadly to sign the ipa file with your own ID.
    
*   [![Sideloadly process done window](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/dc/Sideloadly_process_done.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Sideloadly_process_done.png "Step 3: Wait until Sideloadly reports process as Done. You’ll be able to see Kodi icon on your iDevice.")
    
    **Step 3:** Wait until Sideloadly reports process as Done. You’ll be able to see Kodi icon on your iDevice.
    
*   [![Step 4: Once you see Kodi icon in your iDevice, go in Settings > General > Profiles & Device management and Trust the Apple ID you used which installation.](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/91/Install_kodi_on_ipad_without_jailbreak.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Install_kodi_on_ipad_without_jailbreak.png "Step 4: Once you see Kodi icon in your iDevice, go in Settings > General > Profiles & Device management and Trust the Apple ID you used which installation.")
    
    **Step 4:** Once you see Kodi icon in your iDevice, go in Settings > General > Profiles & Device management and Trust the Apple ID you used which installation.
    
*   [![Step 5: Now you should have kodi working on your iOS device.](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/99/Kodi_on_ipad_in_hand.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Kodi_on_ipad_in_hand.jpg "Step 5: Now you should have kodi working on your iOS device.")
    
    **Step 5:** Now you should have kodi working on your iOS device.
    

**Note:** Due to limitations on free iOS dev accounts, Kodi needs to be sideloaded periodically. If Kodi stops to work, **do not uninstall Kodi**. Instead, repeat all steps to have Kodi working again. Configuration will remain untouched.

[Source](https://forum.kodi.tv/showthread.php?tid=351449&pid=3090702#pid3090702)

# Official:Forum rules - Official Kodi Wiki

[This page is protected so that only users with the "sysop" permission can edit it.](https://mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Help:Protection "This page is protected so that only users with the "sysop" permission can edit it.")

Official:Forum rules
====================

From Official Kodi Wiki

[Jump to navigation](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#mw-head)
 [Jump to search](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#searchInput)

Kodi.tv provides [http://forum.kodi.tv](http://forum.kodi.tv/)
 (the forums) for development, support, and discussion relating to Kodi Media Center.

Contents
--------

*   [1 Registration](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#Registration)
    
*   [2 General forum rules](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#General_forum_rules)
    *   [2.1 General conduct](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#General_conduct)
        
    *   [2.2 No selling or promoting of services for money](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#No_selling_or_promoting_of_services_for_money)
        
    *   [2.3 Posting](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#Posting)
        
    *   [2.4 Signatures and Avatars](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#Signatures_and_Avatars)
        
    *   [2.5 Piracy Policy](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#Piracy_Policy)
        
    *   [2.6 VPN Policy](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#VPN_Policy)
        
*   [3 ADVICE: How do I ask a question in a smart way?](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#ADVICE:_How_do_I_ask_a_question_in_a_smart_way?)
    
*   [4 Disclaimer](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#Disclaimer)
    
*   [5 See also](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#See_also)
    

Registration
------------

By following the link to the forum, you will be able to create a new username. After registration you will receive a confirmation e-mail, which you must accept before being able to post on our forum. The username you want to register **shall not** contain "XBMC" / "Kodi" or any other trademarked, product or company names, unless you represent a non-profit organization or are an official Kodi sponsor. In these cases you must still add your own name to these trademarked, product or company names to differentiate yourself as individual representative.

General forum rules
-------------------

Violation of any of the following General Forum rules will result in a preliminary warning. If violations continue, the forum user will be banned for one week with a note explaining the reason for the ban. If violations continue, the user will suffer a permanent ban. Additionally, if necessary, a Forum Moderator or Administrator may delete or edit posts or signatures at will and without warning. These enforcement policies are slightly different than the Piracy rules, so you are encouraged to read both policies thoroughly before posting.

  
_Forums are not static entities. As need arises, these rules may be altered or added to. Exemptions to any of these rules may be granted by forum moderators._

  
**Note:** While called the "forum rules", they also applies to other official Kodi websites such as the Kodi wiki.

### General conduct

1.  Be civil.
2.  Polite language is required.
3.  Respect the coding efforts of Kodi devs and other coders. Calling a program or add-on “worthless” will be automatically deemed as disrespect.
4.  Respect the efforts of the forum moderators and those answering questions or writing guides. They are working for free in a fairly thankless job.
5.  Make an effort to read any sticky threads in the forum you're posting in, along with FAQs and Online Manuals.
6.  Be patient. Kodi's user base is global and there are many more forum users asking questions than writing answers. Please wait at least 24 hours before bumping your own post unless you have new information to add.

### No selling or promoting of services for money

1.  Do not try to sell services or hardware to individuals on our forums.  
    Exception: If you own a company and want to run a special discount or promotion for Kodi forum members in your shop, contact a member of Team Kodi for permission first.
2.  Do not use usernames to promote your business, product, or website.  
    Exception: We make an exception when the username is in relation to a legal non-profit or the company you represent is an official XBMC Foundation sponsor. Allowed group names must include a personal identifier (e.g. KodiSponsor-Nate or Nonprofit-Nate).
3.  Do not post donation links directly to Paypal or any other donation collections website.  
    Exception: If you are the author of an original work relating to Kodi, you may include one (1) direct donation link in your forum post concerning this work. The link must be written with this exact wording: "Donations for this \[addon/skin/guide/etc\] gratefully accepted."  
    You are allowed to post links to other websites, even if those websites have links to donation sites. For example; Wikipedia requests donations regularly, but you are still welcome to post links to Wikipedia. If you’ve written a guide or created an Kodi addon on your site that’s applicable to a discussion, and your site includes a donation option, you are still welcome to post a link to your website.

### Posting

1.  One topic per thread for ease of management.
2.  All posts should be written in English to ensure uniformity and to make the post accessible to the maximum number of people.
3.  Choose a descriptive thread title. Descriptive thread titles are not only far more likely to be read, but will rank higher in searches and be more helpful to others with the same problem in the future. Use some of the terms you used in your search queries as a base for the thread title.
4.  Be as descriptive and detailed as possible. Assume nothing, there are no mind readers on the Kodi Community Forum.
5.  Post all the the information requested in forum stickies, everything you've tried so far, any suspicions you have. Show that you've made an effort on your own. And remember “the latest release” can mean many different things, so be descriptive in what version of Kodi you are using.
6.  When posting a problem you are encouraged to post a [debug log](https://kodi.wiki/view/Log_file "Log file")
     from when the problem occurred. When posting a log or other lengthy code in the forum, please use a paste site, as described in the **[debug log](https://kodi.wiki/view/Log_file "Log file")
    ** wiki page. Do not post log snippets on the forum, if you want to point out a specific part refer to the line number.
7.  No cross-posting. Do not cross-post or double-post.
8.  Don't misrepresent the work of others as your own.

### Signatures and Avatars

1.  Don’t try to draw excessive attention to your signature through use of large characters, unusual fonts, colors or other effects.
2.  Signatures are to be limited to 4 lines of text or alternatively 1 image with a max-height of 40px (not both).
3.  Avatars and images deemed to be excessively distracting or otherwise counter to the easy reading of the forum will be removed.
4.  Avatars, images and links advertising addons or sources that violate Kodi's piracy policy will be removed.
5.  Signatures and avatars which promote political, religious or other affiliations not related to Kodi are not allowed and may be removed at the discretion of the moderator team.
6.  Links in signatures are to be limited to XBMC.org / Kodi.tv domains and legal sites related to Kodi (For example, a site dedicated to a dev’s Kodi addon). In case of doubt, please consult one of the forum moderator team.
7.  Forum moderators may, at any time and without warning, delete or alter signatures or avatars that violate these rules.

### Piracy Policy

1.  All discussions dealing directly with or linking to add-ons, websites, or services that violate US copyright laws ("pirated content") will be closed when a forum moderator has been made aware of them. The original poster or add-on creator may provide a link to a website not hosted by Kodi for further discussion and inquiries.
2.  Discussions for add-ons that link directly to pirated content and enables the user to access that content through the add-on will be shut down.
3.  All links to pirated content will be removed. Requests on where to obtain pirated content will also removed.
4.  "Pirated content" add-ons, websites, and services typically do not include the following (to be determined on a case-by-case basis if necessary):
    
    **A.** The add-on does not actually perform the act of accessing pirated content ("mistaken identity") \[For example, Sickbeard, which performs no actual downloading or streaming.\]
    
    **B.** The add-on has the potential to access pirated content, but is potentially useful for downloading legal content as well. \[For example, an add-on that downloads torrents is not, itself, a problem, since a torrent can cover a wide variety content, including legally distributed videos.\]
    
    **C.** The add-on links/accesses content in a similar way to a normal web browser. This is done under the assumption that if the content owner did not want the content streamed, the owner should have not made the content available to be streamed in their site. \[For example, the Bluecop Repository.\]
    
    **D.** The add-on accesses content with permission of the content owner, the content is "[copyleft](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/copyleft "w:copyleft")
    ", or the add-on accesses content without the clear disapproval of the content owner. Kodi will do its best to comply with DMCA-related takedown requests.
    
    _Thread originators or add-on developers may petition Forum Moderators to re-open a thread that was closed if he or she believes one of the above exceptions applies._
    
5.  [Fair use](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fair_use "w:Fair use")
     exceptions apply for issues such as small video samples for testing and debugging, fanart and related artwork, video and audio summaries, subtitles, etc.
6.  These rules apply only to the XBMC.org/Kodi.tv websites. At no point will any user be prevented from using Kodi as they so choose, nor will they be prevented from adding additional add-ons from any source they choose to use.

  
_Examples include those seen on this list: **[banned add-ons](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules/Banned_add-ons "Official:Forum rules/Banned add-ons")
**._

### VPN Policy

[VPN Policy](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:VPN_policy "Official:VPN policy")

*   Our policy for the forum is that we do not support them as Kodi does not need one to be used as intended. Any issue arising from their usage should be raised with the VPN provider, especially for commercial ones (you're paying for support as well as access). And any issues with Kodi that are caused by VPN usage are not supported - if the issue remains without using one then report it.
*   We do not allow promotion or recommendation of commercial VPN services ("free" or subscription) as any such commercial promotion is already a violation of our Forum rules. Any such posts and links will be removed, and accounts created solely for the purpose will be banned as spammers.
*   The use of VPNs to overcome geo-locking and other location restrictions put in place by legal and legitimate media providers is not supported by the Team, and discussion on this topic is not allowed on the forum (neither requests for support nor tutorials on how to do it).
*   Whilst VPN add-ons are not classed as [banned addons](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules/Banned_add-ons "Official:Forum rules/Banned add-ons")
    , their advertisement, promotion or support is not allowed here. Any thread requesting or providing such an add-on will be removed. Devices with them installed are still supported on the forum, provided that they otherwise do not violate the [piracy policy](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Forum_rules#Piracy_Policy)
     in other ways.
*   And remember, any VPN is only as secure and as trustworthy as the people providing it. And if it's a commercial entity they may still keep logs which can be obtained by law authorities or be used for other commercial purposes. And if it's a "free" VPN that goes double as they won't be providing the service from the goodness of their hearts. Nor are any VPN entirely and completely private and secure.
*   General VPN related posts which do not violate the policy will be moved to off-topic but will remain open for replies.

  

ADVICE: How do I ask a question in a smart way?
-----------------------------------------------

[How to ask questions in a smart way?](http://catb.org/~esr/faqs/smart-questions.html)
:

*   **When you ask:**
    *   Use meaningful Titles on posts. Don't ask the question in the post title.
    *   If English is a second language for you, then clearly state that in the post.
    *   Be clear, precise and informative about your question and problem
    *   Provide the link to your _**[Debug Log](https://kodi.wiki/view/Log_file "Log file")
        **_ uploaded to a public Pastebin type site. We recommend to use [http://paste.kodi.tv](http://paste.kodi.tv/)
        
    *   Include screenshots to aid in problem description.
    *   Write clearly, with correct use of punctuation and paragraphs. Too much text will put people off reading it. Too little and people won't bother.
    *   Don't ask people to reply by private e-mail or private message.
    *   Courtesy never hurts, and sometimes helps.
    *   Follow up with a brief note on the solution if you find one

Disclaimer
----------

Please remember that we are not responsible for any messages posted. We do not vouch for or warrant the accuracy, completeness or usefulness of any message, and are not responsible for the contents of any message. The messages express the views of the author of the message, not necessarily the views of this bulletin-board. Any user who feels that a posted message is objectionable is encouraged to contact us immediately by email. We have the ability to remove objectionable messages and we will make every effort to do so, within a reasonable time frame, if we determine that removal is necessary.

You agree, through your use of this service, that you will not use this forum to post any material which is knowingly false and/or defamatory, inaccurate, abusive, vulgar, hateful, harassing, obscene, profane, sexually oriented, threatening, invasive of a person's privacy, or otherwise violate any law. You agree not to post any copyrighted material unless the copyright is owned by you or by this forum or is being used in a fair-use context for development.

# Supplemental tools - Official Kodi Wiki

Supplemental tools
==================

From Official Kodi Wiki

[Jump to navigation](https://kodi.wiki/view/Supplemental_tools#mw-head)
 [Jump to search](https://kodi.wiki/view/Supplemental_tools#searchInput)

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [![](https://kodi.wiki/images/a/aa/Home_icon_grey.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/Main_Page "Main Page") |     |     | ![▶](https://kodi.wiki/images/5/5f/TriangleArrow-Right.png) **Supplemental tools** |

This is a list of third-party applications that may help you maintain and modify your media files. Just like Kodi, most of these applications are provided free of charge and survive on donations; please consider doing so.  

**Note:** Inclusion in this list is not a recommendation or endorsement by Kodi.

Contents
--------

*   [1 Music tools](https://kodi.wiki/view/Supplemental_tools#Music_tools)
    
*   [2 Video tools](https://kodi.wiki/view/Supplemental_tools#Video_tools)
    
*   [3 Library managers](https://kodi.wiki/view/Supplemental_tools#Library_managers)
    

  

Music tools
-----------

Exact Audio Copy ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)  

Also known as EAC, this is an efficient audio CD ripper program that's easy-to-use and more intuitive than most others on the market. It handles imperfections with ease and is the ideal choice for an audiophile looking to digitize their disc collection.

*   [_**Website**_](https://www.exactaudiocopy.de/en)
    

Mp3tag ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)  

A powerful and easy-to-use tool to edit the metadata of audio files.

*   [_**Website** (English)_](https://www.mp3tag.de/en/)
     / _([Deutsch](https://www.mp3tag.de/)
    )_

MusicBrainz Picard ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

A cross-platform music tagger written in Python with an easy-to-use interface and the ability to provide detailed, embedded ID3 tags for music files. Kodi has extensive support for the display and filtering of files with ID3 tags.

*   [_**Website**_](https://picard.musicbrainz.org/)
    

  

Video tools
-----------

Aegisub ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)  

A free, cross-platform open source tool for creating and/or editing subtitles that makes it quick and easy to synchronize subtitles to audio and features many powerful tools for styling them and built-in, real-time video previews.

*   [_**Website**_](https://aegi.vmoe.info/docs/3.0/Main_Page/)
    

Avidemux ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

A free video editor designed for simple cutting, filtering and encoding tasks. It's perfect for quickly cutting commercials out of televised recordings.

*   [_**Website**_](http://avidemux.sourceforge.net/)
    

HandBrake ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

A video codec and container converter from nearly any format to a selection of modern, widely-supported ones.

*   [_**Website**_](https://handbrake.fr/)
    

MakeMKV ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

See also: **[HOW-TO:Use MakeMKV Template Pattern with TV Shows](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Use_MakeMKV_Template_Pattern_with_TV_Shows "HOW-TO:Use MakeMKV Template Pattern with TV Shows")
**

Your one-click solution to converting (more accurately, _transcoding_) the DVD and Blu-Ray discs that you own into free and DRM-unencumbered file formats that can be played everywhere.

*   [_**Website**_](https://makemkv.com/)
    

MKVToolNix ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

Converts audio files like MP3 and FLAC into the .mka [audiobook](https://kodi.wiki/view/Audiobooks "Audiobooks")
 format.

*   [_**Website**_](https://mkvtoolnix.download/)
    

Subtitle Edit ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png) 

A free, open source editor for video subtitles.

*   [_**Website**_](https://www.nikse.dk/SubtitleEdit)
    

  

Library managers
----------------

Bulk Rename Utility ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png) 

Allows you to easily rename files and entire folders based upon extremely flexible criteria. Add date/timestamps, replace numbers, insert text, convert case, auto-number serial programming, process folders/subfolders...plus a whole lot more!

*   [_**Website**_](https://www.bulkrenameutility.co.uk/)
    

Ember Media Manager ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png) 

The all-in-one media manager for Kodi on Windows.  
![](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/d6/Attention_talk.png) **[Ember Media Manager on Kodi Forum](http://forum.kodi.tv/forumdisplay.php?fid=195 "forumtopic:195")
**

FileBot ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

The ultimate tool for organizing and renaming your movies, TV Shows and anime, as well as fetching subtitles and artwork for them; it's smart and just works.

*   [_**Website**_](https://www.filebot.net/)
    

Media Companion ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png) 

The original, free-to-use movie/television show manager and organizer that offers full Kodi integration.  
![](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/d6/Attention_talk.png) **[Media Companion on Kodi Forum](http://forum.kodi.tv/showthread.php?tid=129134 "forum:129134")
**

*   [_**Website**_](https://mediacompanion.sourceforge.io/)
    

MediaElch ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

A free media manager built using the Qt graphical framework that can generate [NFO files](https://kodi.wiki/view/NFO_files "NFO files")
 for movies and TV shows from scratch and directly manipulate Kodi's SQLite media library database. Artwork can be fetched from several sites and stored alongside the media files (when using NFOs) or directly in Kodi's thumbnail folder.  
![](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/d6/Attention_talk.png) **[MediaElch on Kodi Forum](http://forum.kodi.tv/showthread.php?tid=136333 "forum:136333")
**

*   [_**Website**_](https://www.kvibes.de/mediaelch/)
    

MediaInfo ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/5/56/Android_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)    

A convenient, unified display of the most relevant technical and tag metadata for video and audio files.

*   [_**Website**_](https://mediaarea.net/en/MediaInfo)
    

Rename My TV Series![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)  

The philosophy is a simple work flow; you have a few odd named TV Show episodes and you’d like to give them a proper name, based on the TV Show name, season, episode and title of the episode. This has been expanded with features like resolution, year, data first aired, etc.

*   [_**Website**_](https://www.tweaking4all.com/home-theatre/rename-my-tv-series-v2/)
    

tinyMediaManager ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/43/Linux_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e4/Mac_OS.png) ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png)   

A media management tool written in Java/Swing for movies, movie sets and TV shows that supports importing/exporting NFO files, downloading artwork and renaming media files themselves along with their corresponding NFOs and artwork in batches.

*   [_**Subreddit**_](https://www.reddit.com/r/tinyMediaManager/)
    
*   [_**Website**_](https://www.tinymediamanager.org/)
    

TV Rename ![](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3d/Windows_OS.png) 

A free tool to keep your TV and movie files organized each into their own folder trees with NFO files (created on-the-fly if not already present) and artwork, plus many other features such as movie collections, artwork scraping and TV Guide integration.

*   [_**Support forum**_](https://groups.google.com/g/tvrename)
    
*   [_**Website**_](https://www.tvrename.com/)

HOW-TO:Install Kodi for Android
===============================

From Official Kodi Wiki

Installing Kodi from the Google Play Store
==========================================

Google Play - stable
--------------------

Kodi is now available on Google Play:

[![](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/df/Google_Play_download_big.png)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.xbmc.kodi)
  
**[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.xbmc.kodi](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.xbmc.kodi)
**

  

Google Play will automatically select which version (ARM(32bit), ARM(64bit) or x86) of Kodi you need, and will also automatically handle updates (unless you change your Google Play preferences).

**Files permissions on Android TV 11 or higher:**

On Android TV 11 or higher by default Kodi dont have local files access permissions, this means that if you try to open any local files through Kodi, these files although existing will not be visible.

To allow Kodi to have access to local files you need to manually set app files permissions. On Android TV settings go to "Settings -> Apps - Kodi -> Permissions -> Files and Media" and select "Allow all the time".

Google Play - beta testing
--------------------------

See also: **[Development builds](https://kodi.wiki/view/Development_builds "Development builds")
**

In order to test Kodi nightlies on your Android device, just download them from here:

[http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/android/](http://mirrors.kodi.tv/nightlies/android/)

  
**Note:** Be sure to **[backup](https://kodi.wiki/view/Backup "Backup")
** before you install this!

These alpha and beta builds are considered "semi stable", and contain the latest changes to Kodi. They may contain bugs and/or drastically change how the program works.

Please report any bugs and issues you come across to the **[Kodi forum](http://forum.kodi.tv/)
**.

  
If you want to go back to the most recent stable version, uninstall the Kodi nightly first and reinstall Kodi either via Google Play or the manual installation which is explained in this article. Uninstalling the Kodi nightly and reinstalling Kodi will reset all Kodi settings. So make sure to **[backup](https://kodi.wiki/view/Backup "Backup")
** your stable Kodi settings before testing nightlies and then restore from that backup once you have stable Kodi installed again.

Manual installation
===================

Enabling installation
---------------------

### Android (normal)

This includes installation instructions for phones, tablets and most boxes running Android.

Here's how to install Kodi from an .APK file. This is commonly known as "sideloading".

*   [![Step 1: First located the settings menu on your Android device and search for the "security" menu.](https://kodi.wiki/images/8/84/Android_install_step01.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step01.jpg "Step 1: First located the settings menu on your Android device and search for the "security" menu.")
    
    **Step 1:** First located the settings menu on your Android device and search for the "security" menu.
    
*   [![Step 2: Now enable "Unknown sources" option. This will allow you to directly install Kodi as easy as you would install it from Play Store.](https://kodi.wiki/images/7/7a/Android_install_step02.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step02.jpg "Step 2: Now enable "Unknown sources" option. This will allow you to directly install Kodi as easy as you would install it from Play Store.")
    
    **Step 2:** Now enable "Unknown sources" option. This will allow you to directly install Kodi as easy as you would install it from Play Store.
    

### Android TV

*   [![Step 1: From the Android TV launcher, scroll down to and select "Settings".](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/ff/Android_TV_install_step01.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_TV_install_step01.jpg "Step 1: From the Android TV launcher, scroll down to and select "Settings".")
    
    **Step 1:** From the Android TV launcher, scroll down to and select "Settings".
    
*   [![Step 2: From the "Settings" menu, scroll down and select the "Security & Restrictions" menu.](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/ee/Android_TV_install_step02.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_TV_install_step02.jpg "Step 2: From the "Settings" menu, scroll down and select the "Security & Restrictions" menu.")
    
    **Step 2:** From the "Settings" menu, scroll down and select the "Security & Restrictions" menu.
    
*   [![Step 3: In the "Security & Restrictions" menu, turn on "Unknown Sources".](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/d6/Android_TV_install_step03.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_TV_install_step03.jpg "Step 3: In the "Security & Restrictions" menu, turn on "Unknown Sources".")
    
    **Step 3:** In the "Security & Restrictions" menu, turn on "Unknown Sources".
    

Download
--------

Download Kodi for Android from the Kodi.tv servers. Official stable builds can be found here: **[http://kodi.tv/download/](http://kodi.tv/download/)
** You need to either select the **ARM** or **x86** version depending on your hardware.

### Android TV

1.  From a desktop computer or phone/tablet, go to [http://play.google.com](http://play.google.com/)
     using the same Google account as used in your Android TV device.
2.  Install a browser such as Chrome. Select your Android TV box from the popup menu after clicking the install/get button.
3.  To make things easy, connect a USB or Bluetooth mouse.
4.  Open the browser either by voice remote (for example, say "Open Chrome") or from something such as Sideload Launcher.
5.  Follow the rest of the steps below for "'Normal' Android"

### Android (normal)

*   [![Step 1: Load up http://kodi.tv/download/ in your Android web browser. Most users will want to use the ARM link, unless you have an Intel or AMD CPU. You may get a warning trying to download the file depending on which browser you use. You should say "OK" to actually download it.](https://kodi.wiki/images/1/1a/Android_install_step03.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step03.png "Step 1: Load up http://kodi.tv/download/ in your Android web browser. Most users will want to use the ARM link, unless you have an Intel or AMD CPU. You may get a warning trying to download the file depending on which browser you use. You should say "OK" to actually download it.")
    
    **Step 1:** Load up **[http://kodi.tv/download/](http://kodi.tv/download/)
    ** in your Android web browser. Most users will want to use the **ARM** link, unless you have an Intel or AMD CPU. You may get a warning trying to download the file depending on which browser you use. You should say "OK" to actually download it.
    
*   [![Step 2: Wait for the "apk" to download.](https://kodi.wiki/images/2/22/Android_install_step04.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step04.png "Step 2: Wait for the "apk" to download.")
    
    **Step 2:** Wait for the "apk" to download.
    

Install
-------

Installing the Kodi app package is as simple as just finding the .apk you just downloaded and opening it up. You can do this either though the download menu in the web browser or selecting it with a file explorer.

*   [![Step 1: After selecting the Kodi apk file you might be asked to select something to open it with. "Package installer", "Google Play", or some similar option will be what you want.](https://kodi.wiki/images/c/c7/Android_install_step05.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step05.png "Step 1: After selecting the Kodi apk file you might be asked to select something to open it with. "Package installer", "Google Play", or some similar option will be what you want.")
    
    **Step 1:** After selecting the Kodi apk file you might be asked to select something to open it with. "Package installer", "Google Play", or some similar option will be what you want.
    
*   [![Step 2: You will get another confirmation screen where you will need to select "install".](https://kodi.wiki/images/0/00/Android_install_step06.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step06.png "Step 2: You will get another confirmation screen where you will need to select "install".")
    
    **Step 2:** You will get another confirmation screen where you will need to select "install".
    
*   [![Step 3: Wait for the installation to complete.](https://kodi.wiki/images/c/c7/Android_install_step07.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step07.png "Step 3: Wait for the installation to complete.")
    
    **Step 3:** Wait for the installation to complete.
    
*   [![Step 4: You've now installed Kodi for Android!](https://kodi.wiki/images/7/70/Android_install_step08.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step08.png "Step 4: You've now installed Kodi for Android!")
    
    **Step 4:** You've now installed Kodi for Android!
    
*   [![First run: The first time you run Kodi it will take slightly longer than normal in order to finish some final installation steps. When it is done Kodi will open normally. This is only done once per installation/update, so the next time Kodi will start up a little faster.](https://kodi.wiki/images/4/4f/Android_install_step09.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step09.png "First run: The first time you run Kodi it will take slightly longer than normal in order to finish some final installation steps. When it is done Kodi will open normally. This is only done once per installation/update, so the next time Kodi will start up a little faster.")
    
    **First run:** The first time you run Kodi it will take slightly longer than normal in order to finish some final installation steps. When it is done Kodi will open normally. This is only done once per installation/update, so the next time Kodi will start up a little faster.
    
*   [![All done!: Once started you are on Kodi home menu just like on any other platform.](https://kodi.wiki/images/3/3a/Android_install_step10.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step10.png "All done!: Once started you are on Kodi home menu just like on any other platform.")
    
    **All done!:** Once started you are on Kodi home menu just like on any other platform.
    

  

If you are new to Kodi you might wish to check out this section of the wiki: **[First time user](https://kodi.wiki/view/First_time_user "First time user")
**.

### Install on Fire TV

This page describes some of the methods to install Kodi onto an Amazon Fire TV (box) or Fire TV Stick. The Fire TV uses Kodi for [android](https://kodi.wiki/view/Android "Android")
 and does not require root. All Fire TV products allow sideloading, so no hacking or modification is required to install Kodi.

See also: **[HOW-TO:Install Kodi on Fire TV](https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Install_Kodi_on_Fire_TV "HOW-TO:Install Kodi on Fire TV")
**

Tidy up
-------

After Kodi has installed you can delete the downloaded Kodi APK file to save some disk space.

Update
------

To update Kodi for Android simply follow the normal install steps with the newer version. All your settings and files will be preserved as they are located in a different place in the userdata folder. Be sure to make a backup of the userdata folder when doing updates in case something goes wrong.

**Note:** Since Kodi for Android is signed with our own signatures you will be able to install all succeeding versions without a problem. If you are using a non-official version not signed by us you may be required to un-install Kodi and you will loose all your settings due to this. Be warned before trying.

  

Uninstall
---------

To un-install Kodi just go to your Android settings menu and select "apps". From there you will be able to un-install Kodi like any other Android app.

### Android (normal)

**Note:** Unlike other OSes, uninstalling Kodi on Android will also erase your [userdata folder](https://kodi.wiki/view/Userdata "Userdata")
 and all of your settings.

*   [![Step 1: Go into your Android "Settings" app and then select "Apps".](https://kodi.wiki/images/2/20/Android_install_step13.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step13.jpg "Step 1: Go into your Android "Settings" app and then select "Apps".")
    
    **Step 1:** Go into your Android "Settings" app and then select "Apps".
    
*   [![Step 2: Select Kodi from the list.](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/f9/Android_install_step14.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step14.jpg "Step 2: Select Kodi from the list.")
    
    **Step 2:** Select Kodi from the list.
    
*   [![Step 3: Select uninstall and confirm.](https://kodi.wiki/images/9/90/Android_install_step15.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_install_step15.jpg "Step 3: Select uninstall and confirm.")
    
    **Step 3:** Select uninstall and confirm.
    

### Android TV

*   [![Step 1: Go into your Android TV Settings menu and then select Apps.](https://kodi.wiki/images/c/c4/Android_TV_install_step12.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Android_TV_install_step12.jpg "Step 1: Go into your Android TV Settings menu and then select Apps.")
    
    **Step 1:** Go into your Android TV **Settings** menu and then select **Apps**.

# Favourites - Official Kodi Wiki

Favourites
==========

From Official Kodi Wiki

[Jump to navigation](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#mw-head)
 [Jump to search](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#searchInput)

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [![](https://kodi.wiki/images/a/aa/Home_icon_grey.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/Main_Page "Main Page") |     |     | ![▶](https://kodi.wiki/images/5/5f/TriangleArrow-Right.png) **Favourites** |

Contents
--------

*   [1 Introduction](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#Introduction)
    
*   [2 Adding to Favourites](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#Adding_to_Favourites)
    
*   [3 Accesing Favourites](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#Accesing_Favourites)
    
*   [4 Modifying Favourites](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#Modifying_Favourites)
    
*   [5 Favourites.xml File](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites#Favourites.xml_File)
    

Introduction
============

Favourites is a simple but useful feature that allows you to gather a selection of different items into one easily accessible location on the _**[Main Menu](https://kodi.wiki/view/Basic_controls#Introduction "Basic controls")
**_. It allows quick access to commonly used items.

As an example, the following items can be sent to the Favourites listing:

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
|     | _Add-ons_ | _Pictures_ |
|     | _Playlists_ | _Movies from the library_ |
|     | _TV Shows and episodes from the library_ | _Music & Video Sources_ |
|     | _Music- Artists, Albums and Songs_ | _Individual Files_ |

...and a lot more. Not sure what can be added? Then highlight the item and check if there is an _Add to favourites_ option in the Context Menu.

  

Adding to Favourites
====================

Items are added to Favourites through the use of the _**[Context Menu](https://kodi.wiki/view/Basic_controls#Context_Menu "Basic controls")
**_.

After highlighting an item (eg a movie) the Context Menu can be invoked by:

*   long press the OK key on your remote control
*   Press letter C on a keyboard
*   right-clicking with the mouse

Then select **Add to favourites** as shown in the image.

*   [![Context menu with Add to favourites selection](https://kodi.wiki/images/e/e1/MovieSets02.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:MovieSets02.jpg "Context menu with Add to favourites selection")
    
    Context menu with _Add to favourites_ selection
    

  

Accesing Favourites
===================

Favourites are accessed from the _**[Main Menu](https://kodi.wiki/view/Basic_controls "Basic controls")
**_.

If the Favourites menu item is not visible then it may have been hidden. Reset the visibility in the skin settings pages. See: _**[Hiding Menu items](https://kodi.wiki/view/Add-on:Estuary/Settings#Main_Menu_Items "Add-on:Estuary/Settings")
**_.

  

*   [![Favourites screen with Movies, TV Shows, Music and Add-ons](https://kodi.wiki/images/0/03/Favourites01.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Favourites01.jpg "Favourites screen with Movies, TV Shows, Music and Add-ons")
    
    Favourites screen with Movies, TV Shows, Music and Add-ons
    

  

Modifying Favourites
====================

*   [![Use the Context menu to modify an item](https://kodi.wiki/images/a/a8/Favourites02.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Favourites02.jpg "Use the Context menu to modify an item")
    
    Use the Context menu to modify an item
    
*   [![Use the Left Sideblade menu to change display options](https://kodi.wiki/images/b/b0/Favourites03.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Favourites03.jpg "Use the Left Sideblade menu to change display options")
    
    Use the Left Sideblade menu to change display options
    

  

Favourites.xml File
===================

Favourites can also be edited directly in the _**[favourites.xml](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites.xml "Favourites.xml")
**_ file in the _**[Userdata](https://kodi.wiki/view/Userdata "Userdata")
**_ folder

See: **[Favourites.xml](https://kodi.wiki/view/Favourites.xml "Favourites.xml")
**

**

# Weather - Official Kodi Wiki

Weather
=======

From Official Kodi Wiki

[Jump to navigation](https://kodi.wiki/view/Weather#mw-head)
 [Jump to search](https://kodi.wiki/view/Weather#searchInput)

|     |     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [![](https://kodi.wiki/images/a/aa/Home_icon_grey.png)](https://kodi.wiki/view/Main_Page "Main Page") |     |     | ![▶](https://kodi.wiki/images/5/5f/TriangleArrow-Right.png) Add-ons | ![▶](https://kodi.wiki/images/5/5f/TriangleArrow-Right.png) **Weather** |

See also: **[Weather settings](https://kodi.wiki/view/Settings/Services/Weather "Settings/Services/Weather")
**

Kodi uses add-ons to provide weather information. You can select from various global and regional weather add-ons and customize various location options.

  

Contents
--------

*   [1 Installation](https://kodi.wiki/view/Weather#Installation)
    
*   [2 Currently available](https://kodi.wiki/view/Weather#Currently_available)
    
*   [3 Temperature units](https://kodi.wiki/view/Weather#Temperature_units)
    
*   [4 Artwork](https://kodi.wiki/view/Weather#Artwork)
    

Installation
------------

The installation of a Weather add-on is required to display weather information within the Kodi interface.

To install a weather add-on, follow these steps:

*   What you'll see in Settings (using the default [Estuary](https://kodi.wiki/view/Add-on:Estuary "Add-on:Estuary")
     skin)
*   [![Image 1](https://kodi.wiki/images/0/01/Services_weather.JPG)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Services_weather.JPG "Image 1")
    
    Image 1
    
*   [![Image 2](https://kodi.wiki/images/d/d3/Weather01.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Weather01.jpg "Image 2")
    
    Image 2
    
*   [![Image 3](https://kodi.wiki/images/f/fb/Weather02.jpg)](https://kodi.wiki/view/File:Weather02.jpg "Image 3")
    
    Image 3
    

1.  Access the Weather Settings page from [**Settings ▶ Services ▶ Weather**](https://kodi.wiki/view/Settings/Services/Weather "Settings/Services/Weather")
    . (Image 1)
2.  Select **Service for weather information**. (Image 1)
3.  If no add-ons are listed, select **Get more...** (Image 2)
4.  From the **Get more...** screen, select your preferred provider. (Image 3)
5.  Once you have selected a Weather add-on to install, enter the **Settings** option shown in Image 1 (no longer disabled once a Weather add-on is installed and available for use) and enter the required location and service details.
6.  Upon completion, you will be able to access the complete weather information from the Kodi main menu and see it displayed more compactly on various pages throughout Kodi according to the skin you're using.

  

Currently available
-------------------

The following weather addons are available in the Kodi repository <dpl> category = Omega\_add-on\_repository category = Weather\_add-ons notcategory = Broken add-ons notcategory = Outdated </dpl>

  

Temperature units
-----------------

To change between _Celsius_ and _Fahrenheit_ temperature units go to [**Settings ▶ Interface Settings ▶ Regional**](https://kodi.wiki/view/Settings/Interface/Regional "Settings/Interface/Regional")
, then select your location under **Region default format** or change the **Temperature unit** setting directly to your preference.

  

Artwork
-------

The default skin [Estuary](https://kodi.wiki/view/Add-on:Estuary "Add-on:Estuary")
, as well as other skins, support fanart backgrounds that can be installed from the [Official add-on repository](https://kodi.wiki/view/Official_add-on_repository "Official add-on repository")
. Other skins may additionally support a user's own collection of weather fanart.

To install a weather fanart pack in Estuary, go to [**Settings ▶ Interface ▶ Skin ▶ Configure skin... ▶ Artwork**](https://kodi.wiki/view/Add-on:Estuary/Settings#Artwork_Settings "Add-on:Estuary/Settings")
 and select **Choose weather fanart pack**. If none are available, you can once again use the _Get more..._ button to download some.

Estuary only uses the default installed weather icons pack and there is no option to change this. Other skins may have the option to change weather icons. These can be installed either from the skins settings pages or activating a new icon pack from **Settings ▶ Add-ons ▶ Install from repository ▶ Look and feel ▶ Image collections**.

Installing either of these may require a restart of Kodi if they do not display immediately.

PVR
===

From Official Kodi Wiki

(Redirected from [Live TV](https://kodi.wiki/index.php?title=Live_TV&redirect=no "Live TV")
)
